Soft opening first, then the doors opened wide.The studio looked back on its soft opening in a post on 25 November 2026.

A name people already knew, finally with a home of its own.

STUDIOinks existed before this address, as an artist and academy name. What is new is the physical North Dallas studio, opened on Saturday 21 November 2026, with a soft opening before it.

Founded by Kimmy Han, the studio is home to an all female team working in fine line. Small, precise work, done in a room that feels calm from the moment you step in.

On 24 November 2026 the studio also shared that it is an official Toys for Tots drop off site, a small sign of how quickly it has settled into the neighbourhood.

From a kolache shop to a dream tattoo studio.

Before. This Preston Road space started life as a kolache shop. The photos here illustrate that change for this demo.

Small lines. Lasting detail.

The studio works across floral stems, anime characters and fine script, all shown in its recent posts. The line stays thin, the placement stays thoughtful, and the piece is made for the person wearing it. Photos on this demo page illustrate the fine line style and studio setting.

What you can book, and what you can walk in for.

Walk ins are accepted during walk in hours. For custom work, flash events and training, the studio takes enquiries by Instagram DM.

Studio Inks Academy

Learn the craft where the craft is practised.

Alongside client work, STUDIOinks runs a training academy for people who want to learn fine line tattooing properly, in a working studio, with a working team.

Trainings are arranged by DM, per the studio bio. If you are thinking about learning, start with a message on Instagram and ask what is coming up next.
